input: Sample complaint SAMPLE-VENTRA-250-CMP-003 (malfunction, patient, death and serious injury all unrecorded, i.e. Unknown), markets not signed; open the disposition and sign with routine=true.
expected_result: routine.offered=false; blocked reason names 'whether the device malfunctioned' and ends 'Unknown is never No'. Sign with routine=true -> 409 ROUTINE_NOT_OFFERED. Resolve and close not full: blocking 'Every relevant market is assessed and signed' until each market is signed.

input: Sign the US market assessment of flagship SAMPLE-RV-11 REPORTABLE (30-day report), then open its disposition.
expected_result: trigger_codes include REPORTABLE ('Reportable outcome', fact 'United States (FDA) concluded reportable'); routine.offered=false with 'An escalation trigger is met'; only ESCALATED_BY_TRIGGER is accepted; routine=true -> 409 ROUTINE_NOT_OFFERED.

input: Turn on urgent_email (PUT /api/v1/oversight/settings/alerts-and-files); log a CONTACT with Q3, Q4, Q5=YES ('The patient died...') and sign COMPLAINT.
expected_result: Triage speed FAST, target_hours 4, acknowledgement due 1 h after reaching triage. Outbox urgent alert queued; e-mail subject 'MDARIX: urgent case received', no patient words. Opted out: nothing queued. Complaint serious_injury=true: trigger INJURY, routine.offered=false.

input: Log a CONTACT with Q2=YES, Q4=YES, Q5=UNKNOWN, rest NO; save triage with severity NOT_KNOWN; sign COMPLAINT and open its disposition.
expected_result: Speed FAST; task TRIAGE_HARM_FOLLOW_UP opened. Complaint patient_involved=true, serious_injury and death null: INJURY trigger value 'Unknown' ('A patient was involved and the outcome is unknown'), on the watch, routine.offered=false. Disposition before triage done -> 422 TRIAGE_FIRST.

input: Log a CONTACT received 6 h ago (Q7=YES, rest NO), sign INQUIRY; QA review with outcome RECLASSIFIED, note 'The caller later said the display froze.'
expected_result: Signed classification COMPLAINT, version 2; history[0].review_outcome RECLASSIFIED; awareness.at = the contact time 6 h ago; status ESCALATED, complaint_id set, qms_task null in a trial; the complaint is listed on GET /api/v1/triage.

input: Investigation with a signed decision: a second approver signs a new decision, first without, then with supersedes_decision_id and a 10+ character reason.
expected_result: Without -> 409 SUPERSEDE_REQUIRED. With -> 200; new decision_identifier ends '-D2'; old decision_status SUPERSEDED, outcome and rationale unchanged, its verification still VALID; audit CASE_DECISION_SUPERSEDED. Any edit to remarks, snapshot or signer makes verification INVALID.

input: Two coordinators open the same unsigned Case check (seen_version 1) and both sign; also two approvers sign the same investigation decision.
expected_result: Case: the second -> 409 NOTHING_TO_SIGN or CHANGED_MEANWHILE. Decision: the second -> 409 SUPERSEDE_REQUIRED. Truly simultaneous Case signing is not tested and the Case sign takes no row lock: TO CONFIRM.

input: Sign a Case SERVICE_ONLY, then the same person does the QA review (AGREED), once in a trial and once outside a trial.
expected_result: Trial: review accepted; history same_person=true; screen shows '(same person)'. Outside a trial: 403 REVIEWER_IS_SIGNER ('The QA review is done by someone other than the person who signed'); refusal audited with why REVIEWER_IS_SIGNER.

input: On a Case with an open QMS-complaint task (Connect), POST /api/v1/intake/{id}/qms with not_needed_reason, as the Case's signer outside a trial and as another quality reviewer.
expected_result: Reason under 10 characters -> 422 QMS_REF_OR_REASON; no quality-review permission -> 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; Case's signer outside a trial -> 403 SAME_PERSON; other reviewer -> task outcome NOT_NEEDED, audit QMS_COMPLAINT_NOT_NEEDED. No password signature in code: 'signed' TO CONFIRM.

input: Withdraw an OPEN Case: reason 'Logged twice by mistake at the desk.' plus password, by its logger outside a trial, then by a colleague, then again; also try on an ESCALATED Case.
expected_result: Logger -> 403 SAME_PERSON. Colleague -> status VOIDED ('Withdrawn: entered in error'), signature CASE_VOID. Again -> 409 CASE_STATE_REFUSED. ESCALATED Case -> 409 CASE_STATE_REFUSED. Reason under 10 characters -> 422 REASON_NEEDED.

input: On an MDARIX complaint, PUT /api/v1/complaints/{id}/reporting-facts with awareness_date 2 days ago, first without a reason, then with 'Reporter's e-mail of 3 Nov'.
expected_result: No reason (or blank) -> 422 CHANGE_REASON_REQUIRED. With reason -> 200; audit COMPLAINT_REPORTING_FACTS_SET with reason, old_values {awareness_date: previous}, new_values {awareness_date: new day}, actor = the user.

input: On an ESCALATED Case, POST /api/v1/intake/{id}/addenda kind WITHDRAWAL, said_by_role REPORTER, text 'Caller says it never happened.'
expected_result: 200; a new addendum row (kind WITHDRAWAL, REPORTER); reporter_words unchanged; audit CASE_ADDENDUM_ADDED; status stays ESCALATED, signed classification unchanged. A changed classification needs a new signed check version. Unknown said_by_role -> 422 ADDENDUM_INCOMPLETE.

input: Trial with a signed COMPLAINT Case of its own and SAMPLE-CALL-02, both with no linked complaint and state OPEN; run python scripts/cases_0_10_93.py.
expected_result: Lists '<ref>: signed complaint, no complaint: ESCALATED by the upgrade, a complaint created (OD-3)' and for SAMPLE-CALL-02 'left for a person to escalate (sample, 9.3)'. No row changes. The writing step and its audit are not in code: TO CONFIRM.

input: As organisation A, GET /api/v1/products/{id of organisation B's product}/links and /product-360?light=1.
expected_result: Both -> 404, detail code PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND, message 'Product not found'; the response body does not contain the ID and holds no counts.

input: As organisation A, GET /api/v1/suppliers/{id of organisation B's supplier}, /complaints and /lots.
expected_result: Each -> 404, detail code SUPPLIER_NOT_FOUND, message 'Supplier not found'; the body does not contain the ID and holds no counts.

input: Import a complaints CSV: row 2 C-1/product P (valid), row 3 C-3 product_id UNKNOWN with 'burned the patient'.
expected_result: Row 2 written with a lineage row: line 2, record_key 'C-1:P', import_ref, mapping_version starting 'complaints-template:'. Row 3 set aside: line 3, problems ['product_id: not found'], harm_words ['burned'], status OPEN. Personal data masked.

input: By SMTP, send to cases-nosuchtoken@<intake domain> and to someone@elsewhere.example.
expected_result: Both RCPT refused with 550 (unknown token: '550 5.1.1 No such recipient here'; other domain: '550 5.7.1 Relay not permitted'). Stored inbound message count unchanged.

input: Send a normal mail to the organisation's intake address; then make it a Case with received_at '2020-01-01T10:00' and channel PHONE.
expected_result: Message state NEW, received_at = server receipt time, raw stored, one INBOUND_MAIL_RECEIVED job. Case: channel EMAIL, channel_ref = Message-ID, received_at = the server receipt time (2020 value ignored); message state MADE_CASE. Second make-Case -> 409.

input: Send the same mail twice with Message-ID <once-only@hospital.example>.
expected_result: Exactly 1 inbound message row with that Message-ID and exactly 1 INBOUND_MAIL_RECEIVED processing job.

input: Send a mail with attachments log.txt (plain text) and run.txt ('#!/bin/sh rm -rf /').
expected_result: log.txt usable with an object_key. run.txt: unusable_reason 'Refused: virus found', object_key null. Stored raw copy ends '-clean', lacks 'rm -rf' and contains 'virus found'.

input: Send a mail with archive.zip and a file over 10 MB; separately send a message over 25 MB.
expected_result: archive.zip: 'Refused: this type of file is not accepted'. Large file: 'Refused: larger than 10 MB'. Message over 25 MB: SMTP 552, nothing stored.

input: Send a mail whose body forwards a message with header line 'Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:00:00 +0000'.
expected_result: header_dates = ['2026-11-02T09:00:00+00:00'], shown as possibly_known_earlier on the e-mail; German text also sets may_not_be_english=true. Awareness is not changed by itself.

input: Two organisations with intake on; send a mail with Message-ID <for-the-first-org@hospital.example> to organisation A's address.
expected_result: Stored in organisation A only; organisation B's inbound message IDs unchanged.

input: Fresh trial: log a CONTACT on a sample product (awareness 5 h ago), then run the sample clock move by 2 h; separately age the trial 3 days after signing a sample market.
expected_result: The logged Case's awareness, received and created times are unchanged; flagship SAMPLE-RV-11 awareness moves +2 h. After a person works on the sample: keep_current returns why WORKED_ON, removal preview clock_stopped=true.

input: Fresh trial read on day 0, then aged to days 7, 15 and 29; also restart the sample (POST /api/v1/trial/sample-data/restart) with and without confirm.
expected_result: Day 0 bell: 3 unread (RV-08 COMMUNICATION OVERDUE, RV-11 and URG-01 TRIAGE DUE_SOON); only RV-09 overdue; 1 CLOSED event. Days 7/15/29 identical. Restart without confirm -> 422; with confirm -> status SAMPLE_RESTARTED, clock running.
